prompt: Every call sends the same 20,000-token system prompt and tool definitions, then a short user question.
why: Cache the stable prefix so repeated calls are cheaper and faster.
trap: The prompt doesn't need shrinking; it needs reuse.

prompt: Cache hit rate is near zero because the system prompt starts with the current time to the second.
tells: Cache hit rate is near zero
why: Put changing content after the stable part; one changing byte early breaks the prefix.

prompt: Users ask many questions about the same 150-page handbook in one session, and each call resends it.
tells: many questions about the same 150-page handbook
why: Cache the handbook prefix across the session's calls.
trap: Retrieval is an option, but if you want the whole doc, cache it.

prompt: Tools are listed in a random order on each request, and caching never kicks in.
why: Keep tool definitions in a stable order so the prefix matches.
